inclusion.I1: Study uses Voxel-Based Morphometry (VBM), fMRI (resting‐state or task based), or FDG‐PET as the imaging modality to analyze whole brain
inclusion.I2: Sample- participants included at least 6 human, clinically diagnosed behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) patients

exclusion.E2: Study should not focus on Parkinson's disease

inclusion.I3: I1- Study uses Voxel-Based Morphometry (VBM), fMRI (resting‐state or task based), or FDG‐PET as the imaging modality
inclusion.I4: I2- Sample- participants included clinically diagnosed behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) or picks disease patients
inclusion.I5: I3- Sample- At least 6 participants in the patient group, and if there is a healthy/control group, at least 6 particpants in the control group
inclusion.I6: I4- CONTRAST- The paper must report at least one group-level analysis that DIRECTLY COMPARES the bvFTD patient group against a healthy control group (e.g. bvFTD < controls, or controls > bvFTD). The following do NOT satisfy this criterion on their own- within-group task activations or condition contrasts computed inside the patient group; comparisons between two patient groups or between patient subgroups (e.g. apathetic vs disinhibited, C9orf72-positive vs negative); correlations or regressions of imaging with behavioural, cognitive or clinical scores; genotype-by-diagnosis or other interaction effects; comparisons against a normative image database rather than a recruited control group.
inclusion.I7: I5- SAMPLE PURITY- In that bvFTD-versus-control comparison, the bvFTD group must not be pooled with other patient groups (e.g. not bvFTD combined with semantic dementia, PNFA, FTD-ALS/MND, or Alzheimer's disease). A paper that reports several patient groups separately is acceptable provided one of those groups is bvFTD alone and is compared with controls.
inclusion.I8: I6- COORDINATES- The paper must report whole-brain results for that bvFTD-versus-control comparison in a defined stereotactic space (MNI or Talairach). It is acceptable for these results to appear in a table of coordinates, in figures, or in supplementary materials, as long as they are clearly described in the text. IMPORTANT- judge the PAPER, not the excerpt you were given. The full text supplied to you may be partial, may omit tables, or may not include supplementary files. Do NOT reject a study because the coordinates are not visible in the text provided; if the paper describes having performed and reported such a comparison, treat this criterion as met. When in doubt, INCLUDE- a qualifying study that turns out to lack usable coordinates is filtered later at the annotation stage, whereas a wrongly excluded study is lost for good.

exclusion.E6: Studies that report only region-of-interest (ROI) analyses with no whole-brain results.
exclusion.E7: Sample- with no concurrent psychiatric diagnosis (e.g., major depressive disorder and bipolar mood disorder), other forms of dementia or neurological symptoms, and no history of alcohol or substance abuse
exclusion.E8: Non-empirical papers (e.g., reviews, meta-analyses, methods-only, simulations) without original data.
exclusion.E9: only reports seed‐based functional connectivity (FC), diffusion tensor imaging (DTI), or cortical thickness methods
exclusion.E10: PET studies using a tracer other than FDG (18F-fluorodeoxyglucose). Amyloid and tau tracers such as 11C-PiB, 18F-florbetapir, 18F-florbetaben, 18F-flutemetamol, 18F-flortaucipir/AV-1451, MK-6240 and PBB3 do not qualify as an imaging modality for this review, even when whole-brain voxelwise results are reported.
exclusion.E11: Case reports and case series (single patients or small consecutive clinical series without a control group).

inclusion.GLOBAL_I1: Whole-brain evidence- The analysis must be from a whole-brain (voxelwise) map
inclusion.GLOBAL_I2: Sample- analysis includes clinically diagnosed behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) or picks disease patients
inclusion.GLOBAL_I3: Analysis must compare the target bvFTD group to healthy controls

exclusion.GLOBAL_E2: Seed‐based functional connectivity (FC), diffusion tensor imaging (DTI), and cortical thickness methods
exclusion.GLOBAL_E3: Explicit evidence of pooling bvFTD group with other patient groups in the analysis (e.g. bvFTD + other dementia group vs controls)

inclusion.DEMENTIA_ALL_I1: Uses Voxel-Based Morphometry, fMRI (resting‐state or task based), and FDG-PET (Fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography) as the imaging modality

inclusion.DEMENTIA_DECREASING_ACTIVITY_I1: Analyses reporting any decreases in activity/connectivity, metabolism, or gray matter volume for bvFTD group (e.g. Control > bvFTD or bvFTD < Control)
inclusion.DEMENTIA_DECREASING_ACTIVITY_I2: Uses Voxel-Based Morphometry, fMRI (resting‐state or task based), and FDG-PET (Fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography) as the imaging modality

inclusion.STRUCTURAL_I1: Uses Voxel-based morphometry (VBM) as the imaging modality

inclusion.FUNCTIONAL_I1: Uses fMRI (resting‐state or task based), and FDG-PET (Fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography) as the imaging modality
